project_type: Browser-based 3D model editor (low-poly focused) using Three.js
test_framework: Manual browser testing (no unit test framework for MVP)
verification_instructions: 1. Run 'npm install' to install dependencies. 2. Run 'npm run build' to verify the project compiles without errors. 3. Optionally run 'npm run dev' to test in browser.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access. Node.js v22 available via nvm. TypeScript available globally.
contribution_requirements: Russian language UI. Export to glTF/GLB and OBJ formats. Flat and smooth shading toggle.
key_patterns: Three.js for 3D rendering. Vite for bundling. Vanilla TypeScript with HTML/CSS UI panels. No heavy frameworks.
directory_structure: src/ - main source code; src/editor/ - core editor logic (viewport, tools, modes, history); src/ui/ - UI panels and toolbar; src/editor/export/ - export to glTF/OBJ; public/ - static assets
